question.prompt: There are 52 sheets of paper, and 18 are used. How many sheets remain? Calculate: \(52-18=?\)

solutions.explanation: There are not enough ones to subtract. Exchange 1 ten for 10 ones, so 52 becomes 4 tens and 12 ones. Taking away the 18 used sheets leaves \(12-8=4\) ones and \(4-1=3\) tens. Thus \(52-18=34\), so 34 sheets remain.
solutions.title: Subtraction with borrowing
